title: VanillaFlux
body:
![Logo of my modpack called VanillaFlux, vanilla+, no new items, mobs or blocks.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2da525d69986aad79355fcb663783baef065c2e5.png) Fed up with bland scenery or clunky menus? **VanillaFlux** breathes new life into every corner of Minecraft—without ever adding a single extra block or item. Imagine… Worlds that feel handcrafted. Ancient towers and hidden ruins rise naturally in your biomes, daring you to explore deeper. Atmospheres that whisper stories. Flickering torchlight, drifting fog, and dynamic shadows make nighttime feel alive. Controls that simply work. Drag, drop, sort, tweak—your inventory and HUD stay out of your way, so you stay in the flow. Stability that never quits. Rainstorms, nether highways, end cities—**VanillaFlux** keeps everything running smooth, whether you’re on a beastly rig or a modest laptop. This is Minecraft, as it was meant to be: raw, beautiful, and utterly immersive. 🙏 Credits & Links Every mod that powers VanillaFlux—huge thanks to the creators!
